processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: API keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket holding model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. ... The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment where the inference gateway runs.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store, intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

trust_boundaries.name: different cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The separate cloud environment containing two of the calling services.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway is placed in the GKE trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The gateway is described as "a FastAPI service on GKE."

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The gateway is described as a FastAPI service, an HTTP application framework.

assumptions.assumption: The model server is placed in the model network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The model server runs on GPU nodes "in our model network."

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store is placed in the model network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The feature store is described as being "on the same network" as the model server, which is identified as the model network.

assumptions.assumption: The calling service is placed in a separate different-cloud trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: Two of the calling services are stated to be "in a different cloud."

assumptions.assumption: The customer features in the Redis feature store are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains account age and spend bands per customer, which are personal data whose disclosure could harm the person or business.
